english: Meanwhile, they should encourage those among us who cannot swim five yards before they are gasping for air.
text: cannot swim five yards before ... 意思是还没游到五码就喘气，不是“喘气前不许游”。把短距离与很快出现的反应相连，带有成人自嘲；among us 将叙述者也放进可能不擅长游泳的人群中。
author: Codex
